About Department of Physical Education

Government Arts and Science College, Idappadi — Dedicated to fostering sports excellence, physical fitness, and Olympic ideals.

Department Vision

To build a vibrant sports ecosystem in Idappadi where rural and semi-urban students discover their athletic potential, cultivate discipline and team spirit, and compete successfully at Periyar University, Tamil Nadu State, and National university games.

Department Mission

  • Ensure 100% digital accessibility to college sports records, tournaments, and equipment.
  • Maintain state-of-the-art sports infrastructure including standard 400m track, clay volleyball courts, net practice pitches, and indoor games facilities.
  • Identify and mentor promising sports talents early in their undergraduate and postgraduate journey.
  • Promote women's athletic participation across Kabaddi, Athletics, Badminton, and Volleyball.

Campus Sports Facilities

Main Oval Ground

Standard open athletics ground with 400m running track, football field, and cricket pitch.

Volleyball & Kabaddi Arena

Clay and mat courts with floodlight facilities for evening inter-departmental tournaments.

Indoor Badminton & Games Hall

Indoor courts for badminton, tournament chessboards, carrom boards, and physical conditioning gear.
